meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and Orca's embedded browser through the `orca` CLI. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "handoff" / "handover" / "give this to another agent", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", or "share skills". Prefer it over raw git worktree, ad hoc PTYs, or Computer Use when Orca state is involved. Use Computer Use only when a visible window needs GUI control that a CLI, filesystem, or API cannot do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行管好代码工作树和终端,把任务交接给下一个智能体继续做
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时开多个代码分支并行干活,还要在智能体之间来回交接任务
copy.tagline_en: Manage worktrees and terminals from the command line, hand tasks off to another agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run parallel branches and pass tasks between agents

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先确定本会话该用哪个 Orca 可执行文件,再拉取与版本匹配的指南,然后按指南用 orca CLI 操作 Orca 的工作树、终端、仓库、自动化、产物、技能分享和内置浏览器。
howto.when: 当你说出 “$orca-cli”、“Orca worktree”、“handoff” 等关键词,或涉及 Orca 工作树、终端、浏览器等 Orca 状态时触发;优先于裸 git worktree 和 Computer Use。

say.text: 开一个 Orca 子工作树,并在里面启动 codex
say.note: 先解析可执行文件,再按版本匹配的指南执行

say.text: 读一下 Orca 终端里的输出,然后往里发一条命令
say.note: 用 orca CLI 读取并发送终端输入

say.text: 把当前任务 handoff 给另一个 agent
say.note: 通过 Orca 工作树交给另一个 agent

howto.what_en: Claude first resolves the Orca executable for this session, loads the version-matched guide via `ORCA skills get orca-cli`, then uses the `orca` CLI for Orca worktrees, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing and the embedded browser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "handoff" and similar, or when Orca state (worktrees, terminals, browser) is involved; preferred over raw git worktree and Computer Use.

say_en.text: Spawn an Orca child worktree and start codex inside it
say_en.note: Resolves the executable, then follows the version-matched guide

say_en.text: Read the Orca terminal output, then send a command to it
say_en.note: Uses the orca CLI to read and write terminal input

say_en.text: Hand off this task to another agent
say_en.note: Hands the work over via an Orca worktree
